reviews.comment: Dr. Chaspari was great. She made ML digestible. She would break the math concepts down into step by step blocks, and strip the core algorithms to their most basic parts so that we could see the processes from start to finish. Had hands on homework's where we would implement what we learned in class. Gentle grading scheme too.

Dr. Chaspari is an awesome lecturer and is passionate about Machine Learning. ML is a topic that can easily be made difficult and this prof does the exact opposite! Believe it or not one of the easiest 400-lvl CS courses here. But you also learn alot, esp if you pay attention and participate. Ample amounts of bonus & e.c., midterm avg was 105%!
